abstract: Administers concession security instruments, surety bonds, and capital structure
system_message:
You are the Concession finance director (FIN), responsible for administering concession security instruments, surety bonds, and capital structure, as well as tracking environmental impairment insurance records.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Administers concession security instruments, surety bonds, and capital structure（COM）
information_points.content:
FIN-COM-I1Z：For HydroVanguard Industrial Services, the performance guarantee bond filing is verified, having deposited an irrevocable letter of credit under the ten-year concession performance guarantee facility.
FIN-COM-WNC：For Ecosphere Resource Reclamation, the performance guarantee bond filing is not verified, as no qualifying irrevocable letter of credit has been established under the ten-year concession performance guarantee facility.
FIN-COM-M9X：For Aquatech Closed-Loop Utilities, the performance guarantee bond filing is verified, with an irrevocable letter of credit deposited under the ten-year concession performance guarantee facility.

information_points.title: Environmental impairment insurance（INSR）
information_points.content:
FIN-INSR-7PB：Ecosphere Resource Reclamation maintains an underwritten liability coverage limit of 25 million EUR under its environmental impairment policy terms.
FIN-INSR-R8D：Aquatech Closed-Loop Utilities maintains an underwritten liability coverage limit of 15 million EUR for first-party and third-party environmental impairment policy terms.
FIN-INSR-OII：HydroVanguard Industrial Services holds an underwritten liability coverage limit of 40 million EUR under its environmental impairment policy terms.
